scope: One independent engineering audit of a fixed already-written trace prefix; zero scientific runs and no original-checker execution.

source.inspection: Verify actual decoder and take method return each freshly JSON-decoded row; lines 705-706 retain all Buchberger rows in a single trace list. Class/method names must be taken from pinned source, not assumed from this description.

runtime.capacity: Parent verifies diagnostic headroom and separate audit guard before launch. Never relax or mutate the active driver guard.

prefix.storage: Read-only existing bytes on the owned sandbox and persistent volume.
prefix.binding: Starting at the first Buchberger row, require exactly the first 495216 consecutive rows with this cell_target and canonical UTF-8 JSON plus LF. Hash only these raw rows in order; no filtering past mismatches, skipped rows, truncation or substitute prefix. Stop after this prefix without requiring completion of the live gzip stream; report that whole-stream EOF/trailer is not validated.

quantity.definition: Lower bound on simultaneously retained storage of actual decoded dict/list containers plus outer trace-list element references for this exact prefix on pinned CPython. Exclude strings, scalars, shared primitive objects, outer-list header/spare capacity, independent checker trace, basis, runtime and allocator overhead.
quantity.independence: Independently author stdlib-only counting code from this quantity and pinned parameters; do not import or inspect prior audit code or totals. Establish decoder container freshness before using additive accounting; a streaming id reuse is not a shared live object.
quantity.comparison: Compare the independently obtained byte total with the original 8589934592-byte RLIMIT_AS. A valid lower bound above the threshold supports conditional retention incompatibility only. A total at or below threshold does not prove fit.

controls.procedure: Retain only the first three actual prefix rows as a tiny sample. Independently count unique complete object-graph storage with identity deduplication, including its outer list, and require the proposed container/reference lower bound not to exceed that complete count.

Use a tiny synthetic outer list with repeated references to the same nested container. Demonstrate why naive repeated container summation is invalid for aliases; the audit must reject applying its fresh-container assumption there or deduplicate accurately.

attempts.watchdog_boundary: 180 seconds is a diagnostic process watchdog. Expiry preserves an inconclusive engineering receipt and authorizes no retry or stop of the original run.

forbidden_reads: parent and prior Coordinator conversations, thoughts, reports and history

seal.rule: Write report once with full independently authored code, exact commands/stdout/stderr, controls, byte total, prefix/source/runtime hashes and read/provenance attestation. Read back SHA256 and bytes and send seal to parent before any prior report comparison. Do not include a self-hash inside the report; no second audit or rewrite after exposure. Parent records the external seal under admission/.

prohibited: No Sage import, field/curve/target construction, root or calibration computation, checker execution, 8GiB allocation or mathematical conclusion.
No mutation of original source/data/runtime/claim, no signals or process termination, no public uploads.
